LightningComponentBundle.description: Send an SMS through WiseCall from a record, a Flow screen or another component. Replies come back to the record.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID
property.description: Lead, Contact or Person Account id

property.name: phone
property.label: Phone
property.description: Optional: preselect this number (must be on the record)

property.name: message
property.label: Message
property.description: Optional: prefill or read back the message

property.name: hideSendButton
property.label: Hide Send button
property.description: Hide the button when a parent calls send() itself
